skills.name: Reconsider
skills.text: Once during his turn, Sun Quan can discard any number of cards to draw the same number.

skills.name: Rescued
skills.text: King Ability: Whenever another member of Wu uses a Peach to save Sun Quan from the brink of death, it provides him with two units of health.

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)
